verdict.rationale: Convex's own Convex Auth library is documented only for social identity providers, one-time email/SMS codes, and passwords. Nothing in the pack shows MFA enforcement or SAML/OIDC enterprise SSO. Convex documents integrations with third-party auth providers (Clerk, WorkOS AuthKit 'built for B2B apps', Auth0), but the pack never ties any of them to MFA or SAML/OIDC through Convex, so these earn no credit for this story.
